description: Player 2's deck for spec 08 at R389's 60-turn cap: 08-do-nothing-b with #100 Ceaseless Void swapped for #75 Infinite Reserves, for the same reason as 08-reserves-a. The card list differs from seat 1's so the spec is not asserting a mirror of one shuffle, but the constraints are identical. The spec's seed (08-turn-cap-26) deals Infinite Reserves into this seat's opening hand, so its library runs dry into Rush Tokens instead of fatigue. Its seat plays under the handicap below, TUTORIAL_HUMAN's (R1705005): a human's resources with a deck of 20, the size every deck had before #1705, so these cards and the deal the spec's seed was tuned on stand.
